title: Private room with private bath: new 3 floor house
description:
Private 1 bed, 1 bath in Nashville’s centrally located Sylvan Park in new three floor townhouse with garage & deck perfect for tanning. 5 minutes from downtown on Charlotte ave, home to Nashville’s best restaurants & close to downtown. Unique, artsy, perfect for influencing, residents, doctors. You’ll have the room downstairs which has a double bed w/ frame, unique decor and a full walk in shower. Furniture is BRAND NEW. Must love dogs, my sweet 3 year Lab will want to be your best friend.

The space
It’s a three floor townhouse, brand new and never lived in before me. Has three bedrooms and three floors. My bedroom is the master and I built a gym and office out of second master. 

The living room, gym, porch and kitchen have everything you’d ever need. And you’re welcome to use them. 

You’ll have access to the whole first floor, lots of privacy, and two entrances one through garage and one through front door. 

The room has ONLY brand new furniture. I mean never been touched lived on slept on, including mattress, bed, bed frame, bedding, chairs, table, tv, etc. it has a huge walk in shower, enormous bathroom, walk in closet, and two windows for great light.

It’s modern, I love the way I’ve decorated it (unique and weird) but classy.

Must love dogs - my Labrador will want to be your best friend.

Guest access
Kitchen, porch, gym, bedroom.

Other things to note
My dog will want to say hi and might bark hearing new people. He’s a lab and he loves everything and everyone but you can close the door

host_details:
Hi I’m Alexa and am moving up from st Pete back to Nashville, and I work in marketing. I’m originally from Boston and have traveled the world including chile and South America (Medellin is a favorite). I have a heart condition called POTS. I have a US navy certified service Labrador who is a joy to be around, and is trained for my condition (rarely has to work). I have all his paperwork, vet records and you will love him. Jagger is easy & sweet.
Fun fact: I have been to hemingways house in Cuba
